title: Homepage hero + primary Call To Action (CTA)
description: Homepage shows a clear value prop and a primary CTA leading to a contact/demo path.

then: a hero section is visible above the fold
a primary CTA button is visible
the CTA navigates to a working contact/demo route

title: Navigation links are present and non-broken
description: Top navigation contains key links and each resolves successfully (no 404).

acceptance.given: a visitor uses the top navigation
then: each link resolves to a page with HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) status 200

title: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) baseline metadata
description: Each public page includes title, description, canonical URL, and Open Graph tags.

title: Contact form submits and stores an inquiry
description: Contact form validates inputs and stores an inquiry record (database or file log) with timestamp.

acceptance.given: a visitor fills the contact form with valid data
then: an inquiry record is persisted with timestamp and fields

title: Responsive design + accessibility baseline
description: Pages render correctly on mobile/desktop and meet basic accessibility expectations.

acceptance.given: the site is viewed on mobile and desktop breakpoints
then: images have alt text where applicable
